messages:
alyssa: Morning folks! quick poll — stairs challenge today? 500 steps/day for 4 days? :muscle: I can start a tiny leaderboard in a sheet. who’s in?

devon: I'm tempted. can we swap to a 3-mile lunchtime run instead? my knees say maybe not stairs 😂

marta: in for steps! will post today's office stair selfie later. here's my route pic: https://i.imgur.com/abc123.jpg :camera:

ryan: count me in for whatever keeps me off the metro. also +1 for a short evening boulder session Friday? @marta @alyssa

alyssa: @devon we can do hybrid — stairs today, run Wed? flexibility wins. i'll start the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example (org-only)

devon: ok hybrid works. @ryan Friday bouldering sounds fun — which gym? i'm free after 6pm

fitbot: Reminder — company wellness perk: reimburse up to $40/month for gym or class passes. Submit receipts via Expensify. :robot_face:

marta: shoutout to @alyssa for organizing! :tada: Also quick poll - what pace for the run? 10min/mile or chill 12?

ryan: 12 please. i'm slow but steady. :sweat_smile:

alyssa: 12 it is. leaderboard will rank streaks not speed. see y'all on the stairs in 10. :running:

devon: uploading route GPX in case anyone wants it:
```
- start: office
- loop: river path -> old bridge -> north park
- distance: 3.1 miles
- elevation gain: ~120ft
```

marta: love it. can't wait for the stair selfie :camera_with_flash:

ryan: I'll bring the energy bars Friday :banana:

alyssa: last call — signing up 2pm PT start. reply 'in' to join.

marta: in

devon: in

ryan: in

fitbot: Registered 3 participants. Good luck! :trophy:
